newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bad loans up 15.2 pct in August - Bank Italy.
newsitem.headline: Italy bad loans up 15.2 pct in August - Bank Italy.

text.p: Bad loans held by Italian banks totalled 118.368 trillion lire in August, up 15.2 percent year-on-year and 0.46 percent month-on-month, the Bank of Italy said in a regular bulletin on Monday.
Banks holding short-term term deposits, accounting for all high street banks, were carrying bad loans of 101.82 trillion lire in August, up 17.6 percent year-on-year and 0.61 percent month-on-month.
Banks holding medium-to-long term deposits had some 16.55 trillion lire of bad loans, up 2.42 percent year-on-year and down 0.49 percent month-on-month.
